name: Plundering the Plunderers
summary: Assigned by the goblin Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet, this rite of passage tests an aspiring Horde rogue against the Southsea Freebooters. Infiltrating the pirate vessel Tide Razor, operatives must bypass the cutthroats, crack the locks in the hold, and neutralize a monstrous avian guardian using goblin technology to claim the Southsea Treasure.

sections.title: A Test of Stealth and Steel
sections.body: For an aspiring operative of the Shattered Hand, raw brawn means nothing without finesse. Wrenix the Wretched, a goblin contact operating out of Ratchet, provides the field test. He directs rogues south along the sun-scorched coastline of the Barrens to a cove anchored by the Tide Razor, a vessel manned by Southsea Freebooters. The assignment is deceptively simple: board the ship unnoticed, break into the pirate den where they instruct their own cutpurses, crack the strongboxes in the deep hold, and bring back their prized plunder.

sections.title: Polly and the Gizmo
sections.body: Reaching the prize requires more than nimble fingers. Wrenix warns that earlier thieves were returned to him in pieces, primarily due to the guardian guarding the vessel's lowest hold: a shockingly savage parrot named Polly. To counter this winged terror, Wrenix provides an experimental device known as an E.C.A.C. When hurled at the vicious bird upon cracking the pirate strongbox, the gizmo disorients and diminishes the beast, turning an impossible death sentence into a winnable duel.

faq.answer: Wrenix the Wretched is a goblin rogue contact based in the neutral port of Ratchet. Working with operatives connected to Orgrimmar's Shattered Hand, he tests emerging thieves by sending them into pirate territory to practice lockpicking and recover stolen plunder.

faq.q: Where is the Tide Razor located?
faq.answer: The Tide Razor is docked south of Ratchet along the eastern coast of the Barrens, nestled inside the Southsea Freebooter enclave. The ship serves as a base and training den for pirate scoundrels.

faq.q: What is an E.C.A.C. and how do I use it?
faq.answer: The E.C.A.C. is an experimental goblin gizmo dispensed by Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus. It is used against Polly, the lethal giant parrot guarding the Southsea Treasure in the belly of the Tide Razor, drastically weakening the beast so it can be defeated.

faq.q: Why is the lockpicking area on the ship significant?
faq.answer: The second deck of the Tide Razor serves as the Southsea pirates' training room. It contains a collection of respawning lockboxes where rogues can practice their lockpicking techniques in field conditions before attempting the main strongbox below.

faq.q: Why is this mission so vital for rogues?
faq.answer: Completing the heist proves a rogue's worth to the Shattered Hand network. As part of your cut, Wrenix rewards you with the secret formula for Thistle Tea, an invaluable herbal brew that rapidly restores a rogue's combat energy.

Polly is the Southsea Freebooters' vicious watchdog parrot stationed inside the lower hold of the Tide Razor. Left unchecked, the bird is lethal to inexperienced infiltrators unless weakened with goblin technology.

angles.text: This rite of passage teaches the essential art of picking locks under pressure and awards the prized recipe for Thistle Tea, making it an indispensable milestone for any operative serving the Horde.
The mission yields the culinary recipe for Thistle Tea, allowing culinary-minded rogues to brew their own proprietary energy tonics from basic herbs and water.
The Shattered Hand uses neutral goblin connections in Ratchet to test prospective field agents against the Southsea Freebooters menacing the Barrens coast.
